name: Stillwater Team Scramble
oneLiner: Stillwater's first Winter league season: a two-person team scramble where every team plays every other team each week for points, 18 holes at a time on a course that changes each week.
beginnerNote: A scramble is the friendliest format there is: you both hit, you take the better ball and go again. Nine holes takes about two hours, and both men and women are welcome.
night: Sundays 3:30pm or 5:30pm, Monday thru Thursday 5:30pm or 7:30pm — you play the same night every week
format: 2-person team scramble against the field, with all teams playing all other teams from every night for points. 18 holes, course varies week to week, about 2 hours.
startDate: Week of November 29th, skip both Christmas and New Years weeks, and runs through week of February 14th.
prizes: Prizes dependent on size of League
